tasks.notes:
# Task #53 — src/commands/init.ts: drop legacy gitignore block, keep the notes-scratch line

## Outcome

`src/commands/init.ts` now has **zero** `ralph` mentions and **zero** removal markers
(`grep -n "remove once all projects migrated\|ralph" src/commands/init.ts` → empty).
All 3 markers are gone.

## What changed

### src/commands/init.ts

- **`GITIGNORE_LEGACY_HEADER` deleted** from this file (see the migrate.ts note below —
  it was rehomed, not dropped, because migrate.ts still needs it).
- **`GITIGNORE_CONTENT` rewritten.** No longer calls `ignoreBlock(LEGACY.tempPrefix)`.
  It is now: current header + `ignoreBlock(BRAND.tempPrefix)` + the single surviving
  legacy line + `instructions.md`. The surviving line is emitted as
  `` `${LEGACY.tempPrefix}task_*_notes.md\n` `` — **still via `LEGACY.tempPrefix`, not a
  bare literal**, exactly as the task specified, because `test/legacy-markers.test.ts` is
  still live and a `.ralph_` literal on that line would fail it. Task **#63** rehomes this
  constant when `LEGACY` is deleted.
- The explanatory comment above that line deliberately says "a legacy-prefixed
  `task_<id>_notes.md`" rather than spelling the prefix out — writing `.ralph_task_...`
  in a comment inside `src/**/*.ts` would itself trip legacy-markers (it matches
  `/ralph/i` on any line, comments included). **Keep it phrased that way until #62/#63.**
- `TEMP_IGNORE_SUFFIXES`, `GITIGNORE_CURRENT_HEADER`, and `ignoreBlock()` are all
  **unchanged and still exported** — `src/commands/migrate.ts` imports all three.
- `getConfigDefaults` doc comment: dropped the "(or legacy ralph.json — remove once all
  projects migrated)" caveat, now just "Loads from an existing cairn.json if present".

### src/commands/migrate.ts — one out-of-scope edit, deliberate

`migrate.ts` **imported** `GITIGNORE_LEGACY_HEADER` from `./init`. Deleting the export
outright would have broken the build (`refreshDataDirGitignore` uses it at what is now
line 72). Rather than leave a dead legacy export in `init.ts`, I moved the constant into
`migrate.ts` as a module-private `const`, with a comment explaining why it lives there:
a fresh `cairn init` no longer emits a legacy block at all, but migration by definition
starts from a pre-rename project and still needs one.

- Behavior of `refreshDataDirGitignore` is **byte-identical** — same string, same
  two-block layout. All migrate tests pass untouched.
- The constant's text still contains the marker phrase, and `migrate.ts` already carries
  the marker at its file header (line ~18), so legacy-markers stays green.
- **Task #60 deletes `cairn migrate` wholesale**, which takes this constant with it.
  No follow-up needed.

## Test changes (TDD — 2 red, then green)

**test/commands/init.test.ts**

1. `creates .ralph/.gitignore with correct content` — rewritten from a pile of
   `toContain` calls to one **exact, ordered** assertion on the non-comment lines:
   ```
   .cairn_complete, .cairn_iterations.log, .cairn_prev_notes, .cairn_task_meta,
   .cairn_completed_ids, .cairn_tasks_snapshot.json, .cairn_task_*_notes.md,
   .ralph_task_*_notes.md, instructions.md
   ```
   Exact-match on purpose: substring assertions can't catch a stray legacy leftover
   (and `.ralph_complete` is a substring of `.ralph_completed_ids`, so a naive
   `not.toContain` pair would have been misleading). ← red #1
2. **New** `keeps ignoring the legacy notes scratch file — agents are still handed that
   name` — pins the exception itself: asserts `.ralph_task_*_notes.md` is present and
   that it is the *only* `.ralph_`-prefixed line. Its comment records *why*
   (buildSystemPrompt still hands agents that filename). ← red #2
3. `does not touch an existing legacy ralph.json` — **deleted**. It asserted that
   `writeCairnJson` leaves a legacy config alone; after #51 removed the `ralph.json`
   fallback from `src/config.ts`, `ralph.json` is just an unrelated file and the test
   asserted nothing about surviving behavior. The adjacent "overwrites an existing
   cairn.json" test still covers what `writeCairnJson` writes.
4. `hook scripts point at the cairn-tts socket, not the legacy ralph-tts one` →
   `hook scripts point at the cairn-tts socket`. Dropped the
   `not.toContain('/tmp/ralph-tts.sock')` assertion (that path no longer exists outside
   `src/brand.ts` after #52). Kept the positive assertion and added a comment noting the
   hooks are the socket's only clients and `findNarrationSocketPath` reads `narrate.sh`.

Red run before the src edit showed exactly those 2 failures (`.ralph_complete`,
`.ralph_iterations.log`, `.ralph_prev_notes`, `.ralph_task_meta`, `.ralph_completed_ids`,
`.ralph_tasks_snapshot.json` still present).

**Left alone as instructed:** the ~70 cosmetic `.ralph` fixture-path references
(`path.join(tmpDir, '.ralph')`, `'Created: .ralph/.gitignore'`, etc.). Note that my two
gitignore tests still use `.ralph` fixture dirs — **task #54 should rename those too**;
the data-dir name is irrelevant to what they assert (`initCoreFiles` takes `dataDir` as
a parameter), so a straight rename to `.cairn` is safe there.

## Verification

- `bun test test/commands/init.test.ts` → **111 pass, 0 fail**
- `bun test` → **859 pass, 0 fail, 31 files** — identical to the #52 baseline
  (one test removed, one added, net zero)
- `test/legacy-markers.test.ts` green, including its extra assertions
- Health check `bun build --target=bun src/index.ts --outfile /tmp/cairn-healthcheck` → OK
- Did **not** touch `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck`; did **not** run `./install.sh`

## Notes for later tasks

- **#54** (cosmetic fixture rename): also covers the two gitignore tests I edited — see
  above. The exact-match list in test 1 hardcodes `.cairn_*` / `.ralph_task_*_notes.md`
  *strings* (gitignore line contents), which are independent of the fixture dir name;
  only the `path.join(tmpDir, '.ralph')` lines need renaming.
- **#60** (delete migrate): removes the rehomed `GITIGNORE_LEGACY_HEADER`, and with it
  the last consumer of `ignoreBlock`'s prefix parameter being called with anything but
  `BRAND.tempPrefix`. After #60, `init.ts`'s exports of `TEMP_IGNORE_SUFFIXES`,
  `GITIGNORE_CURRENT_HEADER`, and `ignoreBlock` have no external readers and could be
  made module-private.
- **#63** (delete `LEGACY`): `init.ts`'s only remaining `LEGACY` use is
  `LEGACY.tempPrefix` on the surviving notes line — the permanent exception. That plus
  `src/commands/run.ts:52` are the two call sites the rehomed constant must serve. When
  rehoming, the *value* must stay `.ralph_` (it is the filename agents are told to write),
  and the comment in `GITIGNORE_CONTENT` can finally spell it out once
  `test/legacy-markers.test.ts` is gone (#62).

No discovered tasks this iteration.

tasks.title: Decide the fate of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain — no production callers remain
tasks.description: Task #51 deleted warnIfLegacyApiKey and its two call sites (src/commands/narrate.ts, src/commands/run.ts), which were the only consumers of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain(). The function is still exported from src/config.ts and covered by test/config.test.ts, but nothing in src/ calls it — the resolution is now purely documentary, mirroring the same chain in lib/cairn_narrate_server.py (see task #59). Either (a) delete the helper, its AnthropicApiKeyResolution type, and its tests, leaving the Python server as the single implementation, or (b) keep it and give it a real caller — e.g. have runNarrate/runRun pass the resolved key into the narration server env instead of relying on the child process re-reading the environment. Do NOT normalize onto plain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY under either option: the loop deliberately blanks that name to force Max-plan usage. Sequence this after #59 so both sides of the mirror are decided together.
